title: Supplementary material: Real-time capsizing-risk warning for ships in extreme seas — code, data summaries and results
description: Code, per-voyage Monte Carlo summaries, test-set predictions and result files that reproduce every number and figure in the paper 'Real-time capsizing-risk warning for ships in extreme seas: a hybrid nonlinear-dynamics and probabilistic machine-learning decision-support framework' (submitted to Maritime Transport Research).
